sections.heading: AirPods and the Environment
sections.source_text:
See the AirPods 5 Product En­viron­men­tal Report (PDF)
Progress towards Apple 2030
Apple 2030 is our goal to be carbon neutral across our value chain. We design our products to be less carbon intensive by prioritising the use of recycled and renewable content and low‑carbon materials while focusing on the energy efficiency of our software and hardware.
See Apple’s commitment
Materials
AirPods 5 are made with 40% recycled content,
16
including:
100% recycled aluminium in the hinge of the case
100% recycled cobalt in the battery
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
95% recycled lithium in the battery
70% recycled plastic in the wireless charging case
17
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
Packaging
100% fibre‑based packaging
18
Energy
35% of manufacturing electricity for AirPods 5 is sourced from renewable electricity
19
Exceeds US Department of Energy requirements for battery charger systems
20
Waste
No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Programme
21
Smarter Chemistry
22
All of the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our
Regulated Substances Specification
, which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest
Environmental Progress Report
to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.

sections.heading: AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case
sections.source_text:
Model number: A3439, A3440, A3441
Year introduced: 2026

sections.heading: Wireless Charging Case for AirPods 5
sections.source_text:
Model number: A5329
Year introduced: 2026
The Wireless Charging Case for AirPods 5 is compatible with Apple Watch and Qi-certified wireless chargers. There’s a USB-C port on the bottom of the case for plug-in charging. There’s an external speaker on the bottom of the case to indicate charging and battery status. The status light is on the front of the case. And the serial number is on the underside of the lid.
The Wireless Charging Case for AirPods 5 is compatible with two AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case earbuds. It's not compatible with AirPods 5 earbuds or any other AirPods earbuds other than AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case earbuds.
